entities.name: Guanylate kinase Q89MV4
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed Bradyrhizobium diazoefficiens guanylate kinase Q89MV4; EC 2.7.4.8.
Catalyzes ATP-dependent phosphorylation of GMP to GDP, producing ADP (Rhea:20780).
Guanylate_kin domain PF00625 detected at residues 18–196; protein length 219 aa.

entities.name: GMP phosphorylation RHEA:20780
observations: GMP + ATP = GDP + ADP; reaction mapped to EC 2.7.4.8 guanylate kinase activity.
